verdict.rationale: The evidence covers Gitea's issue features (branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies) and the pull-request workflow. None of it documents linking commits or pull requests to issues, or closing or updating issues automatically from keywords in commit messages. Issue tracking is a fair axis for a Git forge, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages
